text_block_list.text:
The day has finally arrived. It's time for
the
mysterious ball that Фудзи Кисэки
invited me to!

Hmph. It's about time. You've got some
nerve
making me wait.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Okay, everyone's here now! I can't wait
any
longer, so let's get going already!
Vamos!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
The art gallery's multipurpose hall is
serving as
the venue. Are you ready?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Sí! We'll settle that dance battle from
the other
day once and for all! Right
here, right now!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: I was hoping you'd say that!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
The two dancers lock eyes and smile. I
can feel
their intense passion from here!
To the ball!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса and Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: The blinding spotlights, the crowd of guests... Ah yes, now this is a ball!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
But... don'tcha think this is kinda
different from
what you imagined?
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Does everybody have their pom-poms
ready?!
Let's see those dance moves!
text_block_list.name: Cheerleader Girl

text_block_list.text:
Ho-ho-ho! Soiya-sassa! Mmhmm! My
joints are
feeling good!
text_block_list.name: Older Man in Happi

text_block_list.text:
Cheerleaders and traditional happi
coats?! Is
there no dress code at all?!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Welcome, my darling ponies. Thank you
for
coming.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: Fuji! Um, what is with this... unique ball?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
It's a gathering of local dance groups
that love
dance more than anything.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
They all love to dance? All right! I love
anything
that's fun!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Hold on, El. Are you serious? You can't
talk like
that to people you've only just
met!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Hehe, it's quite all right. Everyone here
loves to
dance, so we're all kindred
spirits.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Cha-cha-cha! ♪ Cha-cha-cha! ♪ I love it!
You're
all so talented!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Indeed, I do believe inviting you all was
the right
decision.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
This is an event that transcends genre
and
generations, so I've invited people
from all walks
of life to come and have
fun.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
The concept is simple—everyone come
together
and dance! And please do try
to enjoy yourselves!
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
A gathering for everyone... So that's
what Fuji
meant...
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Then leave it to my first-rate self to
show
everyone the perfect dance to
really get this
party started!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's the way! I do know how hard
you've
worked in preparation for today.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Would you care to share a dance with
me?
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: I'd love to!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Кинг Хало and Фудзи Кисэки perform a
captivating
dance that draws the
attention of everyone at the
venue.

It's so beautiful! Their tails twirl
whenever they
spin!
text_block_list.name: Cheerleader Girl

text_block_list.text:
Wow, how elegant! It almost feels like
we're in the
guest hall of a castle.
text_block_list.name: Older Man in Happi

text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Everyone was captivated by your
dance.
Many thanks for bringing joy to
the guests.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
But of course! I am the belle of the
ballroom. The
shining star of the dance
floor!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
...You resembled nothing less than an
angel who
had descended from heaven.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: Ngh?!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: W-well, I am first-rate! Perhaps I just can't help being seen that way! Ohoho!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Uhhh. So, everyone! Keep watching as I
continue
to dance for you all!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Phew... Thank you very much! I had so
much fun!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
As did I. Thank you for such a wonderful
time, my
dear pony.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, young lady in the emerald
dress? Do
you have a moment?
text_block_list.name: Older Person in Formal Wear A

text_block_list.text: But of course. How may I help you?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
We, the members of the Ballroom Dance
Society,
would be very honored if we
could share a dance
with you.
text_block_list.name: Older Person in Formal Wear A

text_block_list.text: Indeed we would. Myself especially.
text_block_list.name: Older Person in Formal Wear B

text_block_list.text: Mumble mumble... shuffle shuffle...
text_block_list.name: Older Person in Formal Wear C

text_block_list.text: W-wait, with all these people?!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
...No, what am I saying? If they all wish
to dance
with me, the only first-rate
solution is to dance
with everyone!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Кинг Хало has a dizzyingly fun time
surrounded by
a crowd of dancers.

After doing just that, Кинг Хало looks
exhausted,
but very proud of herself.
